title: Allow grouped instances to be optionally sorted manually or alphabetically instead of by order of opening
line: With the Task Manager set to sort alphabetically, the windows inside a group are now listed alphabetically by title.
explanation: Alphabetical sorting in TasksModel compares tasks by app name and falls back to opening order when the names match. Every window inside a group belongs to the same app, so group popups and tooltips always listed windows in the order they were opened, whatever sort mode was picked. In alphabetical mode, windows inside the same group are now compared by window title (opening order only breaks ties); top-level tasks and every other sort mode are unchanged.

commits.message:
libtaskmanager: sort windows inside a group by title in alphabetical mode

With alphabetical sorting, all windows in a group share the same app name,
so they were listed in the order they were opened. Sort them by their
window title instead, keeping opening order only for identical titles.

BUG: 422704

media.caption: Sort: Alphabetically, four Dolphin windows opened as Charlie, Alpha, Delta, Bravo: the group popup lists them in opening order
Same setup with the fix: the group popup lists Alpha, Bravo, Charlie, Delta

reviews.text: Clean, well-scoped change in libtaskmanager/tasksmodel.cpp that sorts windows inside a group popup alphabetically by window title (Qt::DisplayRole via localeAwareCompare, with source row tie-breaking) when sortMode is SortAlpha, without affecting top-level task sorting or other sort modes. Reusing the existing Alphabetically sort mode complements existing manual in-group reordering in SortManual mode without adding redundant settings UI, and the screenshots and verification confirm both initial ordering and live re-sorting on title changes. (Minor nitpick: guarding the earlier separateLaunchers block with !left.parent().isValid() would also protect library callers that combine launchInPlace with SortAlpha, though Plasma's Task Manager only enables launchInPlace in SortManual.)

Nate narrowed the wish to alphabetical or manual order inside groups; manual reordering of grouped windows already works in Manual mode (TasksModel::move takes a parent), and this makes the Alphabetically mode also sort a group's windows by title, which closes the remaining half. The change is small, confined to children of the same group in SortAlpha only, and title changes re-sort because the sort role is DisplayRole in that mode. It does bring back title-driven reshuffling that the existing comment avoids for top-level tasks, but only inside groups and only for users who picked Alphabetically, which is what the bug asks for. Screenshots clearly show opening order before and alphabetical order after; a tasksmodeltest case would be a nice addition.
